<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple footer (model footer@1): the brand, one line about the site, the links as a list in a nav and the
  copyright line. Axes: layout (row: the brand beside a row of links, grid: the brand beside the links in two or
  three columns, centered: everything centred).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { FooterLink } from "./footer-simple.types";

  export type FooterSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    brand: string;
    description?: string;
    links: FooterLink[];
    copyright: string;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    layout?: "row" | "grid" | "centered";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    brand,
    description = "",
    links,
    copyright,
    padding = "compact",
    layout = "row",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: FooterSimpleProps = $props();
  const frame = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "centered" ? "flex flex-col items-center gap-8 text-center"
    : (layout as string) === "grid" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2"
    : "flex flex-col gap-8 md:flex-row md:items-start md:justify-between"
  );
  const linkRow = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "grid" ? "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3"
    : (layout as string) === "centered" ? "flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-6"
    : "flex flex-wrap gap-6"
  );
  const copyAlign = $derived(((layout as string) === "centered") ? "center" : "start");
  const copyText = $derived(((layout as string) === "centered") ? "text-center" : "text-start");
</script>

<Block
  tag="footer"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="footer-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
      <Box class={frame}>
        <Stack gap="2" align={copyAlign} class="max-w-sm">
          <Text size="lg" weight="bold" class={copyText}>
            {brand}
          </Text>
          {#if description}
            <Text size="sm" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", copyText)}>
              {description}
            </Text>
          {/if}
        </Stack>
        <Box>
          <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", linkRow)}>
            {#each links as l (l.id)}
              <ListItem data-slot="footer-link">
                <LinkPlain href={urlOf(l.href)} class="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
                  <Text size="sm">
                    {l.label}
                  </Text>
                </LinkPlain>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
        </Box>
      </Box>
      <Text size="xs" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", copyText)}>
        {copyright}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
